_comment: Reconstruction of the issued CoachHub SOW as an intake file. Used as the round-trip fixture: rendering this should reproduce the real document's structure and language. Treat it as the reference example for sow_type=gemini_enterprise_implementation.

business_challenges.label: Information Overload & Retrieval
business_challenges.summary: Reducing the time employees spend searching for, synthesizing, and summarizing information spread across support tickets, CRM records, and team conversations.

business_challenges.label: Workflow Inefficiencies
business_challenges.summary: Accelerating routine tasks such as drafting communications, creating customer-facing documentation, and generating reports.

business_challenges.label: Meeting & Task Management
business_challenges.summary: Improving productivity by streamlining scheduling, summarizing discussions, and seamlessly tracking action items.

user_community: Additional users will be selected from the CoachHub side to validate the various functionalities of Gemini Enterprise across different departments and roles as part of the production implementation.

agentic_workflows.name: Chief of Staff
agentic_workflows.description: integrates with Gmail and Google Calendar to provide users with a daily morning summary of their emails, calendar events, and key team communications.

out_of_scope_extra: Development of new or custom connectors, agents, and actions beyond what is described in this SOW.
out_of_scope_suppress: Development of new or custom connectors and actions beyond what is described in this SOW.

success_criteria: Complete end-to-end set up and system integration on Customer's Google Cloud environment with functional connectors.
Users can effectively search and retrieve information across integrated systems.
Timely onboarding of users using a scalable framework with minimal technical issues with adoption across the organization.
Positive customer feedback and successful handover, ensuring readiness for future scalability and collaboration.

unanswered: Customer signatory title and phone number were left TBD in the issued document.
